messages: After much hardship, I finally managed to gather all the materials #p602# asked for. Now, I can only trust in his power.
With #p602#'s help, I awakened the #t1302009#, entrusted to me by #p502#, into the #t1302014#. All that remains now is to return the sword to #p502#.

It seems that this #t1302014#, which #p502# told me about, is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing between the #b#t1302014##k and the #b#t1032013##k that #p502# offered me, but I don't regret my choice.
name: Hero's Gladius
